**9 issues found** across 53 files
Prompt for AI agents (unresolved issues) ```text Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them. When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P2: This render scans the full posted ledger three times because `balanceSheet` recomputes `incomeStatement` after the page already requested it. Use a combined report service or share one trial-balance snapshot to avoid the repeated database and memory work. P2: The report page performs three full trial-balance scans for two panels because `balanceSheet` recomputes income internally. Use one combined report query or share a single trial-balance snapshot to avoid duplicate database work. P2: The action accepts arbitrary date strings, but `createInvoice` compares them lexically. Validate and normalize both dates at this boundary, or make the service compare parsed calendar dates, so callers cannot create invoices with an earlier due date. P2: No production module imports this service, so budgeting cannot be reached by the application even though its integration tests pass. Wire these operations into a server action/page before shipping, or remove the dead service until it has a caller. P2: The period validation accepts nonexistent months such as `2026-13`, allowing invalid budgets and misleading zero-actual reports. Validate the month range (`01`–`12`) in all three service entry points and enforce the same calendar constraint in the database. P2: The `bigint` columns no longer enforce the engine’s 2^31−1 journal-line cap, allowing invoice and POS postings above that limit. Add an upper-bound CHECK or keep these columns `integer` so every journal writer shares the same constraint. P2: These foreign keys allow a tenant-scoped record to reference another organization’s account, invoice, company, contact, product, or sale. Enforce `(org_id, id)` ownership with composite unique keys and composite foreign keys (or equivalent database constraints) so a bad write cannot corrupt tenant isolation. P2: `postJournal` bypasses the accounting line cap, allowing large invoices to post journal lines above `MAX_LINE_AMOUNT`. Validate the generated lines or reject totals above the cap before inserting them. P2: The period check accepts invalid months, causing silent no-ops for `MM=00` and database errors for `MM>12`. Restrict the month to `01`–`12` in both the server validation and the form pattern. ```
Reply with feedback, questions, or to request a fix.

**3 existing issues remain and 14 new issues found across 37 files (changes from recent commits).**
Prompt for AI agents (unresolved issues) ```text Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them. When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P3: This row breaks the Markdown table and documents an invalid month pattern because its alignment whitespace is inside the regex. Escape the alternation pipe and remove the internal padding. P2: This test does not create or interleave any concurrent posting, so it cannot validate the concurrency guarantee stated in the test comment. Add a deterministic interleaving or concurrent post/read scenario that would fail when the report combines different snapshots. P2: This FK test never exercises `invoices` or `invoicePayments`, despite claiming coverage for all three tables. Add valid, dangling, and cross-org inserts for both tables (and deletion assertions if cascade is required), otherwise those constraints can regress without this test catching it. P3: The new comment names the POS table incorrectly; change `pos_sales_items.qty` to `pos_sale_items.qty` so the database reference matches the schema. P3: This declaration separates `computeLineTotals` from its existing JSDoc, so the exported function loses its documentation. Move `QTY_DB_MAX` above the function’s JSDoc block. P2: `period` is not validated before filtering, so direct callers can request an impossible month and receive an empty trial balance or income statement without an error. Validate the `YYYY-MM` format and `01`–`12` range in the service before querying. P3: `financialReports` duplicates the complete balance-sheet calculation already in `balanceSheet`, creating two implementations that can drift. Extract a `balanceSheetFromTb` helper and use it from both functions so the combined report preserves one source of truth. P3: This report tells future agents to investigate and fix five defects that this PR already resolved. Mark the findings as resolved or remove the stale prompt so subsequent automation does not duplicate completed work. P2: These period links use the server's local timezone instead of WIB, so Indonesian users can receive the wrong “Bulan ini” period around month boundaries. Derive the year and month with the existing `jakartaDateISO` helper or an `Intl` formatter using `Asia/Jakarta`. P2: This query has no ordering guarantee, so indexing `afterSale[1]` makes the test flaky. Select the movement by `reason` (or add an explicit order) before asserting its quantity. P2: `restock` discards the transaction result and re-reads after commit, so a concurrent restock can make it return another operation's stock. Return the transaction promise and remove the post-commit query. P2: The fiscal-period lookup runs once per active asset inside the transaction, adding N serial round trips for an organization with N assets. Load the relevant closed periods once before the loop and check each asset’s range in memory. P2: `dispose` now commits the status change without recording the existing `asset.dispose` audit event. Call `recordAudit` with `tx` before returning so every disposal remains traceable and atomic. P0: Migration 0018 creates the composite foreign keys before creating the referenced `(org_id, id)` unique keys, so PostgreSQL rejects the first FK and the migration cannot complete. Add all parent unique constraints before any composite foreign keys. ```
**Requires human review**: Auto-approval blocked because this review re-detected 3 unresolved issues already reported by Cubic.
